clusters.headline: Trump Indicates Military Engagement With Iran Has Effectively Ceased
aiSummaryBullets: President Trump stated that military conflict with Iran is effectively over but remains ready to respond if circumstances shift.
Recent reports indicate a global decline in fossil fuel emissions attributed to the impact of the ongoing conflict and renewable energy growth.

clusters.headline: Explosions Reported In Strait Of Hormuz Amidst Diplomatic Efforts
aiSummaryBullets: Explosions were reported on Qeshm Island and on tankers following encounters with sea mines in the Strait of Hormuz.
Iran has officially removed the previous 2,000-kilometer range restriction on its ballistic missile program.
